message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts.

Fact: 黄某某 rides bicycle, follows victim driving three-wheeled motorcycle, pretends to be hit, pretends to call family, uses this to extort 500 yuan from victim.

This is extortion (敲诈勒索). The act: pretended accident to obtain money. That's extortion. No other crimes like false accusation? He pretended to be injured, but didn't actually cause injury. He used deception to obtain money. That's "敲诈勒索". Also possibly "诈骗"? But extortion is more appropriate: using threat or deception to obtain money. The list includes "敲诈勒索". So answer: [罪名]敲诈勒索<eoa>.

Check if any other charges: maybe "诈骗"? The act is to obtain money by deception, but extortion is more specific: using false claim of accident to demand money. In Chinese law, extortion (敲诈勒索罪) is about using threats or false allegations to obtain property. So yes.

Thus final answer: [罪名]敲诈勒索<eoa>
